page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-144 is a general-purpose server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. It features 144 vCPUs mapped to 72 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 540 GB of RAM, translating to 3.75 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results place this instance in the top tier for multi-core CPU performance, as demonstrated by stress-ng and PassMark CPU scores. The Intel Xeon processor includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions, which contribute to top-tier performance in extended instructions, encryption, and physics simulations. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with both read and write operations on large blocks ranking in the top ten percent. Single-core performance is moderate, with stress-ng single-core tests placing in the middle fifty percent, though Geekbench single-core scores reach the top tier.

The c4-standard-144 is highly capable for parallelized workloads, including software compilation, ray tracing, database operations, and static web serving, all of which score in the top tier. It also demonstrates strong performance in large language model inference, particularly for prompt processing across small, medium, and large models. Given its high resource density and dedicated CPU allocation, the instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for compute-heavy, multi-threaded enterprise applications that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
